title: Brokoli task runtime protocol v1 (ADR-033 section 7)
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for one brokoli.task-runtime/v1 control/event frame -- the duplex JSON Lines protocol between a trusted worker and the one-shot task harness process it launches for a 'task' node attempt. This schema validates one DECODED frame's shape; it cannot express the wire-level framing rules (UTF-8, LF-terminated, 1 MiB max, no duplicate keys, no literal unescaped newline) or the start->ready->events->completed|failed state machine -- see docs/schema/task-runtime-v1-framing.md for those. This is a rollout-phase-0 artifact (ADR-032/033 rollout, issue #439 step 5): no Go/Python/Node code speaks this protocol yet. Distinct from and does not replace ADR-029's framed binary pool protocol (pkg/codeexec), which continues to govern 'code' nodes exclusively per ADR-035 Decision 3.

frame.description: Any valid v1 frame, either direction. worker_frame travels on the harness's stdin; harness_frame travels on its stdout.

worker_frame.description: Frames the trusted worker sends to the harness (stdin).

harness_frame.description: Frames the harness sends to the worker (stdout). The state machine is start->ready->(log|progress|warning|metric)*->(completed|cancel_ack)|failed -- see the framing companion doc for the full terminal-state rules this schema cannot express.

invocation_path.description: Fixed by the trusted worker, scoped beneath the attempt sandbox; the harness cannot be redirected to a different path by any frame.

deadline.description: The harness must reply cancel_ack and exit by this deadline.

capabilities.description: Must satisfy every capability 'start' required, or the handshake fails (ADR-033 section 7 rule 4).

fields.description: Structured log fields -- replaces the legacy ADR-029 wrapper's stdout text-prefix convention entirely for task-runtime/v1.

completed.description: Monotonic per scope (ADR-033 section 7 rule 9) -- a future decreasing value is a protocol-level anomaly, not expressible as a single-frame schema constraint.

category.description: ADR-033 section 14's failure taxonomy. Task-supplied category/code/retryable are advisory only for user_code/contract_violation/dependency/resource_exhausted/cancelled/deadline_exceeded -- only the trusted worker may originate runtime_protocol/platform/resource_exhausted/lease_lost, and only the control plane determines final retryability (rule 8).

stack.description: Redacted according to policy before it leaves the worker.
